Statements.Statement: id, report_id, patient_id, version_number, source_report_name, patient_name, patient_gender_code, patient_birth_date, patient_phone_number, age_at_report, identity_document_type_code, identity_document_no, visit_type, visit_serial_no, application_dept_id, application_dept_name, application_doctor_id, application_doctor_name, execution_dept_id, execution_dept_name, report_dept_id, report_dept_name, report_doctor_id, report_doctor_name, review_doctor_id, review_doctor_name, review_time, inpatient_no, ward_name, room_name, bed_no, application_time, report_time, source_modified_time, received_time, pdf_file_id, pdf_file_name, source_confidential_flag, oper_id, oper_time
select coalesce(max(version_number), 0) as max_version_number from mrec_medical_report_version where report_id = $ReportId

select v.id, v.report_id, v.patient_id, v.version_number, v.source_report_name, v.patient_name, v.patient_gender_code, v.patient_birth_date, v.patient_phone_number, v.age_at_report, v.identity_document_type_code, v.identity_document_no, v.visit_type, v.visit_serial_no, v.application_dept_id, v.application_dept_name, v.application_doctor_id, v.application_doctor_name, v.execution_dept_id, v.execution_dept_name, v.report_dept_id, v.report_dept_name, v.report_doctor_id, v.report_doctor_name, v.review_doctor_id, v.review_doctor_name, v.review_time, v.inpatient_no, v.ward_name, v.room_name, v.bed_no, v.application_time, v.report_time, v.source_modified_time, v.received_time, v.pdf_file_id, v.pdf_file_name, v.source_confidential_flag, v.oper_id, v.oper_time, r.status as report_status,
case when r.current_version_id = v.id then 1 else 0 end as is_current_version,
case when exists ( select 1 from mrec_medical_report_version n where n.report_id = v.report_id and n.version_number > v.version_number ) then 1 else 0 end as is_superseded from mrec_medical_report_version v
join mrec_medical_recognition_report r on r.id = v.report_id where v.report_id = $ReportId order by v.version_number asc, v.id asc

insert into mrec_medical_report_version ( id, report_id, patient_id, version_number, source_report_name, patient_name, patient_gender_code, patient_birth_date, patient_phone_number, age_at_report, identity_document_type_code, identity_document_no, visit_type, visit_serial_no, application_dept_id, application_dept_name, application_doctor_id, application_doctor_name, execution_dept_id, execution_dept_name, report_dept_id, report_dept_name, report_doctor_id, report_doctor_name, review_doctor_id, review_doctor_name, review_time, inpatient_no, ward_name, room_name, bed_no, application_time, report_time, source_modified_time, received_time, pdf_file_id, pdf_file_name, source_confidential_flag, oper_id, oper_time ) values ( $Id, $ReportId, $PatientId, $VersionNumber, $SourceReportName, $PatientName, $PatientGenderCode, $PatientBirthDate, $PatientPhoneNumber, $AgeAtReport, $IdentityDocumentTypeCode, $IdentityDocumentNo, $VisitType, $VisitSerialNo, $ApplicationDeptId, $ApplicationDeptName, $ApplicationDoctorId, $ApplicationDoctorName, $ExecutionDeptId, $ExecutionDeptName, $ReportDeptId, $ReportDeptName, $ReportDoctorId, $ReportDoctorName, $ReviewDoctorId, $ReviewDoctorName, $ReviewTime, $InpatientNo, $WardName, $RoomName, $BedNo, $ApplicationTime, $ReportTime, $SourceModifiedTime, $ReceivedTime, $PdfFileId, $PdfFileName, $SourceConfidentialFlag, $OperId, $OperTime )
